sentences.en: Conclusions Lumbar dorsal muscle physiological cataplasia of female happened earlier than male, and intramuscular adipose degeneration happened earlier than muscle morphology atrophy.

sentences.en: Fusing in lower intervertebral of lumbar would evoke much more cataplasia in the adjacent segment.
